question: Calibrate the grants-per-recipient-line function n(d) used by mission_exception_per_grant.py from published size bands instead of the beta sweep: fit n(d) to JCF FY2023 (75,380 / 1,908 / 76 grants under $50k / $50k-$1m / over $1m against 2,955 / 1,276 / 109 Schedule I lines, same fiscal year) and Fidelity CY2021-24 grants of $1m+ (1,180 / 1,407 / 1,345 / 1,971 vs 1,183 / 1,280 / 1,295 / 1,708 lines of $1m+), then rerun the per-grant exception shares
conclusion_affected: Exception share per grant (g0401-g0502 §B); AI value pool per grant
rationale: The beta sweep (0-1) drives the broad per-grant exception share (17-31%). At the top end one line is about one grant (Fidelity ratio 0.86-1.15), which rules out beta near 1; at the bottom JCF lines under $50k bundle about 25 grants each
